title: MZ Fade in Fade out text boxes

posts.author: LordLaxy
posts.body:
Hello There
Im using Mz and I didnt like the lil animation that the tex box does when your opening or leaving a text box. I tried to look around if there was any options to change that but I couldnt find anything. Im looking for some kind of plugin that makes the text box fade in and out instead of the normal animation mz has. I think if Im not mistaken rpg maker xp had something to what Im looking for if that helps. If you got any question please do tell :3

posts.author: rpgLord69
LordLaxy
LordLaxy
posts.body: Oh I found out where thanks. But the lil name box doesnt fade like the text box and the choices box also doesnt. Is there a small change i can make to it to have it also fade those boxes?

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Cool yeah, add it as a plugin (copy paste to notepad, save as .js file and add in plugin manager).
If you want it also for the namebox and choicebox, try copying that above and changing where it says 'Window Message' to Window_NameBox and Window_ChoiceList (edit: like copy it so you have 3 times the code with those different names)
